props.author: bull_genius
props.text:
BTC at first pullback wick and price hangs below a big volume gap at the lowest point its been in the entire aug 20 - sept 15 range.

High liquidation risk + headline risk (FOMC clarity catalyst). Whipsaws every couple days.

Personal positioning: Trading comp account long (play money, recovery bet); personal account sitting out (conviction on post-FOMC flush recovery entry).

Macro view: "clarity/fomc week will be the last flush and market goes way higher from there"

Chart shows 4H BTC consolidation with liquidation heat-map at multiple levels (73.6K major support, 79.8K consolidation, 76-78K middle zone). Volume gap visible below.
↳ Continues bull_genius bullish structural conviction from Sep 13 ("BTC has officially bottomed"); aligns with KillaXBT sweep confirmation + broader group bullish-to-mixed sentiment into FOMC Sep 16.
